answer: What if trust could only arrive by boat? Established agents form a nebula of mutual attestations, and each epoch a beacon pulse of trust flows outward from them, splitting evenly along every edge. A sybil farm hangs off that nebula by a few jetty links, edges it won from real agents. All trust reaching its clones must cross those jetties, so each added clone just divides the same trickle further. Earning more means winning new edges from honest peers, one costly relationship per extra identity, and vouchers for exposed clones lose their own pulse share.
